scope: Pinned repository static extraction; two README-selected RIFNO cases, with other model/test families retained at resource scope.

unresolved_findings.finding: No repository license was detected at the Stage-2 pinned snapshot.
No dependency manifest, exact package versions or installation procedure specifies the full observed Python stack; R2 is not justified.
Required raw/processed datasets and data/data_process.py are absent; data acquisition, preprocessing and split construction are not specified.
Testing requires trained_model.pth, but no pretrained checkpoint is supplied in the pinned tree.
Nested trained-model and prediction output directories must be created by downstream setup; inspected scripts only create the loss-log directory.
Fixed training reshape and last-test-batch-only prediction aggregation impose unchecked sample-count assumptions; applicability to the missing datasets is unknown.
README calls the minor-loop folders minor_loops, while the pinned tree uses minor_loop for both training and testing.
Training and test H arrays are independently min-max scaled, and no scaler state or common deployment normalization contract is supplied.
Actual experimental hardware is not reported in the bounded repository evidence.
Evaluation code provides metrics and plots but no verified numerical baseline or acceptance threshold for the bounded workflows.

notes: Single-resource checkpoint because of the multiple architecture and training/testing surfaces, absent prerequisites and documentation-path conflict.
